quotes.text: Governance in fabric isn't a stack of policies you forget to enforce. It's the operating system for your data life, identity, permissioning, lineage, classification, policy, and monitoring, wired into one-lake, workspaces, items, and compute.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Defines Fabric governance concisely as an integrated operating system rather than a policy list.

quotes.text: Governance without lineage is theater. Fabric's built-in lineage maps how a raw capture flowed into a processed mesh into a compressed LOD set into a robot training simulation and finally into a KPI dashboard showing training efficiency.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Illustrates end-to-end lineage with a concrete 3D asset example.

quotes.text: Governance isn't separate from productivity. It's fused to it. People do the right thing by default because the platform translates policy into the path of least resistance.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Reframes governance as a productivity enabler built into the platform.

quotes.text: If you remember nothing else: version the manifest, pin dependencies and treat rights as first class versioned components. The rest of your governance will stop feeling like theater and start behaving like engineering.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Clear, actionable recommendation for versioning digital twins.

quotes.text: Digital trust isn't a promise. It's enforcement at runtime with receipts. Real-time 3D just forces you to admit it.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Memorable closing thesis on runtime enforcement of governance.

chapters.title: Versioning and provenance of digital twins

takeaways: 3D assets and digital twins are constellations of meshes, textures, scans and rights, which makes them the hardest test for Microsoft Fabric governance.
Entra ID identity, lineage, classification labels and OneLake shortcuts let one canonical asset serve many teams without brittle copies.
Version twin manifests, pin dependencies and treat licenses as machine-readable, versioned components enforced at access time with time-bound tokens.
hook: 3D models and digital twins break folder-based governance: rights, versions and lineage scatter across tools and regions. This episode shows data and platform teams how Microsoft Fabric governance with Entra ID, lineage, OneLake and rights-as-code keeps even real-time 3D assets compliant and traceable.
